newsitem.title: HONG KONG: NW Infra to buy Datang stake at IPO price.
newsitem.headline: NW Infra to buy Datang stake at IPO price.

text.p: New World Infrastructure Ltd (NWI) said its purchase of a 9.9 percent stake in Beijing Datang Power Generation Co Ltd would be paid at the initial public offering price yet to be set for the H-share listing candidate.
NWI gave no details on the public offering price in a statement published on Tuesday.

"The cash required for the investment will be financed by the company from internal resources...and it is the present intention of the company to obtain bank loans to refinance the investment cost at a later stage," NWI said.
"The directors considers that such bank financing will not have a material adverse effect on the company's cash flow or gearing," it added.
Beijing Datang, a subsidiary of North China Power Group Co, operates coal-fired power plants which supply electricity to Beijing and other industrial cities in northern China.
Market sources expect Datang to raise about US$300 million through a dual listing in Hong Kong and London in March.
H-shares are shares of mainland Chinese companies listed in Hong Kong.
